title: The Handoff Doc Trick That Keeps Claude Code Sharp
description:
Most people don't know what a handoff doc is, and it's the single biggest miss I see in how people use Claude Code.

Here's how it works. When your Claude Code thread starts to slow down or get dumber, that's context running out. Ask Claude to summarize everything you just did in that thread. Take that summary and drop it into a brand new chat as the first message. Your new thread picks up exactly where the old one left off, with fresh context. It performs like the first prompt you ever sent it.

This is one of the most useful prompts in my whole Claude Code workflow.

#claudecode #ai
